title: Sunday · lanterns, lit
logline: The Grunion beach the Sunday after the run, at night, in the strip's memory: dozens of lanterns lit along the surf, a landscape of small lights. The year the color could do night.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach at night, dozens of lanterns along the surf line, their lights doubled in the wet sand, the sea black beyond.

image.prompt: a night beach with dozens of lanterns along a surf line doubled in wet sand and a black sea beyond, no words

panels.name: Lights

panels.composition: Tier 2: the surf, silver with fish, in lantern light.

image.prompt: a surf line silver with small fish in warm lantern light, no words

panels.name: Fish

panels.composition: Tier 3: the beach from far down it: the lights a string, the bluff, the town's few windows above. Held.

image.prompt: a long night beach seen from far along it with a string of lantern lights and a few town windows on a bluff above, no words

panels.name: Far

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The year the color could do night. Dozens of lanterns; compare 2019's nine.
